text: Confirmed and filed #6591: APPEND FROM TYPE CSV imports a UTF-8 BOM-prefixed header as a data row. VFP9 SP2 help says CSV field names on the first line are ignored; installed VFP COM imports only ALICE,HELLO from BOM+NAME,NOTE header fixture. Copperfin imports 2 rows, first NAME begins U+FEFF. Distinct from #6579 embedded-newline parsing. Issue is verified open and owner-authored, labeled bug/runtime/agent-approved. No production changes.
